What are stem cells?

In recent years, "regenerative medicine" has attracted attention in a wide range of fields, from treatment of health problems to beauty-oriented treatments. Regenerative medicine is a medical technology that aims to restore damaged tissues and lost functions by leveraging the regenerative ability of cells within our bodies. As a result, progress is being made in the development of treatment methods for injuries and illnesses that were previously difficult to treat.

Stem cells play a particularly important role in the field of regenerative medicine. Stem cells have the ability to divide and proliferate due to their self-renewal ability, and at the same time have the ability to differentiate into various types of cells such as blood vessels, heart muscle, bone, and fat.

Types of stem cells

Stem cells are cells that exist in our bodies, and one of the most representative types is mesenchymal stem cells. Mesenchymal stem cells are found in a variety of locations, including bone marrow, fat, umbilical cord, and milk bone marrow.
In the past, stem cell therapy derived mainly from bone marrow was common, but recently stem cells derived from adipose tissue have been attracting attention. This is because stem cells are abundant, have high growth factors and immunosuppressive potential, and are relatively easy to harvest.

Stem cells that can be collected

Bone marrow derived

In addition to mesenchymal stem cells, there are two other types of stem cells: hematopoietic stem cells, which are the source of blood. These stem cells have a high capacity for nerve regeneration and are suitable for treating blood-related diseases such as stroke and spinal cord injury. There is a burden on the patient's body, such as pain and inconvenience associated with harvesting bone marrow. In addition, there are reports that the content of bone marrow-derived stem cells is small, and when cells are collected from elderly people, their proliferation rate slows down with age.

derived from fat

A small amount of adipose tissue, approximately 1 to 2 grams, is collected from body parts such as the abdomen. Since this method is close to the body surface, the burden and risks to the body during collection are greatly reduced. In addition, the content of adipose-derived stem cells is 500 times higher than that of bone marrow-derived stem cells, and not only do they have a high proliferative capacity, but they also contain many growth factors that are effective in organ repair.

Umbilical cord origin

The umbilical cord, also known as the umbilical cord, receives nutrients and oxygen from the mother through the blood flowing through it. This precious cord blood contains hematopoietic stem cells that can only be collected during childbirth, and these can be used to treat blood disorders such as leukemia and aplastic anemia.

Derived from baby teeth

Stem cells collected from tooth tissue are said to have excellent proliferative ability and extremely strong regenerative power. Because it is surrounded by the hard tissue of the tooth, it is thought that the risk of affecting genes is low.

About the effects of stem cell treatment

Treatment using stem cells is a new technology, so not all aspects are yet understood. Because of this, we sometimes face unintelligible criticisms such as ``insufficient evidence.'' However, through patient and repeated clinical experiments, it has been established as a new treatment approved by the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare.

It has become clear that the effects of stem cell therapy are extremely wide-ranging, but under the current system, the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare only approves individual treatments for specific diseases for which there are extremely few side effects and therapeutic effects are recognized.
Our hospital is a medical facility that has submitted a Type 2 Regenerative Medicine Provision Plan to the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare and obtained a plan number in accordance with the "Act on Securing the Safety of Regenerative Medicine, etc." (Act on Assuring Safety of Regenerative Medicine, etc.).

Diseases and conditions for which research suggests stem cell therapy is effective

vascular disease

Lower limb ischemia due to myocardial infarction, cerebral infarction, early renal failure, dementia, and diabetes

neurological disease

Infantile paralysis, dementia, cerebral infarction, Parkinson's

Diseases related to bones and cartilage

Rheumatism and osteoarthritis

Other diseases

Diabetes, liver disease, immune disease (intractable collagen disease), asthma, etc.

Preventive effect

Disease prevention, whole body rejuvenation, etc.

Aging care effects related to beauty

Rough skin, acne, enlarged pores/dirt, craters, lack of firmness/gloss, smile lines, dark circles, wrinkles around the eyes/mouth, loose face line, sagging cheeks, double chin, etc.

About stem cell treatment at our hospital

Stem cell drip/stem cell injection

At our hospital, we perform stem cell infusions to treat chronic pain where only pain remains even after the period required to treat the disease. Stem cells that enter the blood vessels engraft on injured nerve cells and have the effect of repairing and regenerating the damaged area. Through this effect, it relieves pain caused by chronic inflammation.

In addition, stem cell injections can be expected to improve aging facial skin, wrinkles and age spots, and tighten sagging skin.

Who we recommend for stem cell infusions and injections at our hospital

  • Pain that persists or recurs for more than 3 months
  • Pain that persists for more than a month even after the cause of the pain (illness or injury) has healed
  • Pain associated with chronic illness or irreversible injury
  • The stains have increased
  • My face has lost its firmness
  • Acne scars won't go away

Regenerative medicine video

Flow of stem cell treatment

1counseling

Our staff and doctors will ask about your symptoms, physical condition, medical history, etc., and determine whether stem cell treatment (regenerative medicine) is possible.

2blood test

Depending on the blood test results, additional tests may be required.

3Harvesting stem cells

Adipose tissue is harvested from the abdomen.

4Stem cell processing (culture)

Stem cells are separated from adipose tissue and cultured for about a month.

5Administer stem cells

After checking the quality, the stem cells will be administered intravenously or subcutaneously.

6Postoperative follow-up and medical treatment

Follow up regularly to check the degree of improvement.

Side effects and downtime of stem cell treatment

side effects

・Temporary fever, headache, back pain, etc.
*Stem cell therapy is a treatment in which your own cells are administered. There is almost no need to worry about serious side effects such as rejection or allergies.

risk

・When cells are collected or administered (injected), there will be a tingling pain from the needle.

downtime

・There is almost no downtime. After your treatment, you can apply light make-up when you go home.
・You can wash your face and take a shower on the day of your treatment.
・You can take a bath from the day after the treatment.

Management system based on the Act on the Safety of Regenerative Medicine, etc.

For stem cell treatment at our hospital, stem cells are prepared at our attached cell culture processing facility.
We will keep your cells under a reliable management system that complies with national and legal standards.

Features of Norris Clinic's regenerative medicine and stem cell treatment

Our hospital focuses on regenerative medicine, and performs stem cell treatment in which stem cells are cultured and administered from your own cells.
Stem cell therapy promotes activation of surrounding cells and recovery of their functions by administering stem cells, and various beauty effects can be expected.
The effects will vary from person to person, but you will notice them in about 3 to 6 months, and there are almost no worries about major side effects.
The features of our hospital's regenerative medicine and stem cell treatment are as follows.

Regenerative medicine that is close to the patient

At our hospital, we strive to provide regenerative medicine that is tailored to each individual.
Stem cell treatment will not be performed if it is determined that it may have a negative effect on the patient.

We offer a variety of menus to meet your concerns and wishes other than regenerative medicine.

In addition to regenerative medicine and stem cell therapy, we offer a menu of treatments tailored to the wishes of our patients, including hair growth promotion, skin quality improvement through laser therapy, and medical hair removal.
In order to achieve beauty and smiles for many of our patients, we offer consultation on a wide range of beauty issues, including wrinkles, sagging, and hair loss.

A location and environment that is safe and easy to visit even after treatment

Treatments are by reservation only, and we are working to ensure privacy by installing partitions in the waiting room.
Also, since it is near the station, it is conveniently located for follow-up follow-up and medical treatment after stem cell treatment.

Frequently asked questions about regenerative medicine and stem cell therapy

What is the difference between regenerative medicine and stem cell treatment at other hospitals?

Type 2 regenerative medicine includes methods that use ``fibroblasts'' and ``stem cells.'' "Fibroblasts" produce ingredients that promote skin regeneration, such as collagen, hyaluronic acid, and elastin. On the other hand, "stem cells" are young cells that can differentiate into various cells, and can be said to promote the regeneration of not only fibroblasts, but also keratinocytes, blood vessels, nerves, and the skin itself. Our clinic is characterized by the use of "stem cells."
In addition, skilled culture techniques are required to cultivate stem cells. Our clinic outsources the culture to the Grandsol Immunology Institute, a facility that boasts one of the best culture technologies in Japan, and provides high-quality stem cells.

How many treatments are required?

You can feel the effect after just one treatment. Stem cells live in the body for several years, but skin damage accumulates due to individual differences and over time after administration, so we cannot guarantee that everything will be cured in one treatment. In fact, it is true that all treatments are more effective if performed multiple times.

Do you ever think that you have had cosmetic surgery?

Unlike treatments that use artificial substances such as hyaluronic acid or threads, stem cell treatments rely on the patient's own regenerative powers, so we can expect natural anti-aging effects. On the other hand, it takes several months to feel the effects.

What is the aftercare after treatment?

At our clinic, patients come regularly for free checkups after receiving stem cells. We check on the patient's condition after treatment and consult with them regarding their concerns, skin care, and the use of other treatments.
